div.head: Grið 23
div.ab: Swilce syndan Godes gyfa, þe eaþe mæg of lytlan aræran to miclan eall þæt he sylf wile, eal swa se sealmscop soðlice sæde, þa ða he þus sang: ‘Quis sicut dominus Deus noster’ et rl., ‘suscitans a terra inopem et de stercore erigens pauperem, ut collocet eum cum principibus, cum principibus populi sui’.

Swilce syndan Godes gyfa, þe eaþe mæg of lytlan aræran to miclan eall þæt he sylf wile, eal swa se sealmscop soðlice sæde þa ða he þus sang: Quis sicut dominus Deus noster et reliqua, suscitans a terra inopem et de stercore erigens pauperem ut collocet eum cum principibus, cum principibus populi sui.

Solches sind Gottes Gaben, der leicht aus Kleinem zu Grossem erheben kann alles, was er selbst will, ganz wie der Psalmdichter wahr sagte, da er folgendermassen sang: ‘Wer [ist] wie der Herr, unser Gott’ u. s. w., ‘der aufrichtet von der Erde den Dürftigen und vom Kothe erhebt den Armen, dass er ihn setze neben Fürsten, neben die Fürsten seines Volkes’.

Such are the gifts of God, who can easily raise from small to great whatever he himself wills, just as the psalmist truly said when he sang thus: ‘Who [is] like the Lord our God’ etc., ‘who raises up the needy from the earth and lifts the poor from the dung, to set him with princes, with the princes of his people’.

Such are the gifts of God, who can easily raise from insignificance to greatness all that he himself wishes, just as the psalmist truly said when he sang thus: Who is as the Lord, etc., raising up the needy from the earth, and lifting up the poor out of the dunghill that he may place him with princes, with the princes of his people.
div.note: Liebermann compares Psalm 112.5 and 112.7 f.; T: corrected against Rabin, DOML 66 (2020), p. 28 (before: ‘Swilce syndan Godes gyfa, þe eaþe mæg of lytlan aræran to miclan eall þæt he sylf wile, eal swa se sealmscop soðlice sæde, þa ða he þus sang: Quis sicut dominus Deus noster et reliqua,suscitans a terra inopem et de stercore erigens pauperem ut collocet eum cum principibus, cum principibus populi sui.’); T: corrected against Rabin p. 28, October 2026 (was “Swilce syndan Godes gyfa, þe eaþe mæg of lytlan aræran to miclan eall þæt he sylf wile, eal swa se sealmscop soðlice sæde þa ða he þus sang: Quis sicut dominus Deus noster et reliqua, suscitans a terra inopem et de stercore erigens pauperem ut collocet eum cum principibus, cum principibus populi sui.”, now “Swilce syndan Godes gyfa, þe eaþe mæg of lytlan aræran to miclan eall þæt he sylf wile, eal swa se sealmscop soðlice sæde þa ða he þus sang: Quis sicut dominus Deus noster et reliqua, suscitans a terra inopem et de stercore erigens pauperem ut collocet eum cum principibus, cum principibus populi sui.
